purpose: Design of the four forge wrapper SKILLs (query/update for rules/specs) that delegate document search and index updates to external backends, defining skills, arguments, output contract and SKILL contract.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and index updating to doc-link or doc-db backends via wrapper SKILLs
Skill list with fixed category and user-invocable settings for query-db-rules/specs and update-db-rules/specs
Query SKILL argument {task} and execution flow with backend order resolution and availability check
Query does not maintain indexes; delegates to update SKILLs with a confirmed backend after approval
Error when no backend is available; no grep fallback
Output contract: Required documents path list built by script, common across backends
SKILL contract: inherited-type search SKILL without context fork, allowed-tools, args limited to keywords and short task text
Update SKILLs flow with --backend override and desired-state semantics based on .doc_structure.yaml
Preconditions: at least one backend available, judged by capability not version
Tests and lints covering the wrappers, backend selection, worker roles and index maintenance boundary
tasks: Designing backend selection or fallback behavior for document search
Calling document search SKILLs from other forge SKILLs
Reviewing the SKILL contract for inherited search SKILLs
Adding tests or lints for document search wrappers
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
